description: This Java class manages the view logic for account items in an Android RecyclerView, including binding account data, handling UI interactions, and context menu operations.

classes.name: ManageAccountViewHolder
classes.description: RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass responsible for binding account data to UI components and handling user interactions for account management in the Android app.

methods.name: ManageAccountViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with the item view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds account data and sets up UI event handlers, including context menu options based on API version support, and highlights the current account.
